To register a cosmetic establishment, an entity must obtain Form FD-2511 (“Registration of Cosmetic Product Establishment”) from the Food and Drug Administration at 5001 Campus Dr., College Park, MD 20740, or from any FDA district office, and then mail the completed form to Cosmetic Product Establishment Registration, Food and Drug Administration, 5001 Campus Dr., College Park, MD 20740 [1].

Form FD-2511 is the required form for registering a cosmetic establishment [1].
